verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sandboxes that accept custom images with 'any dependency', a 'full, isolated dev environment' for agents, and a TCP port probe. None of it documents running a headless browser or a full desktop environment (GUI/VNC) inside a sandbox. Installing a browser through a custom image would be a developer-built workaround from general building blocks, not a documented capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox
